newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Hintze says euro will start on time.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Hintze says euro will start on time.

text.p: Peter Hintze, general secretary of Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats (CDU), said on Monday it was wrong to pit stability criteria against the time schedule for the introduction of the single European currency.
Hintze said that the euro would start on time in 1999 and the debate about whether the time schedule versus the stability criteria was counterproductive.
"The stability criteria as the anchor of the European economic and monetary (EMU) will remain firmly in place and are irrevocable," Hintze said before a meeting of CDU leaders in Berlin.
He added: "The euro will start on time."
